questions.prompt: Which resource creates a Juju workspace?
questions.explanation: juju_model creates a workspace for applications.

questions.prompt: What computed attribute of a model must applications use to reference it?
questions.explanation: Use juju_model.<name>.uuid to reference a model from an application.

questions.prompt: Which block is required inside every juju_application resource?
questions.explanation: The charm block specifies which charm to deploy.

questions.prompt: For a subordinate charm, what should you do with the units field?
questions.explanation: Subordinate charms do not have their own units.

questions.prompt: Can you set both units and machines on a juju_application at the same time?
questions.explanation: units and machines are mutually exclusive.
